facts.fact: 手枪真相：Lumin pistol——Lumin 投射力十倍、「designed to hurt. To maim. To kill.」——「The ost Krülins are touted as being geniuses. In truth, they are murderers. What a legacy to live up to.」
facts.anchor: The ost Krülins are touted as being geniuses.

facts.fact: Rian 请枪：「Let me prove that light can be more than a force of destruction...used for good」——「I also need redemption...I can deliver it for us both.」
facts.anchor: Let me prove that light can be more than a force of destruction,

facts.fact: 断臂与宣告：Taesia 影分身围杀 Varrick（「When it was Phos who began this war」「You're just too indoctrinated」）——「I am not the puppet of a god.」「I am a god.」——Starfell 挥入其颈（双臂之力才斩断）。
Orsus 复苏：骨镯脉冲——pale whispery voice（Bone Palace 旧声）——「…go…him…」「Not… interfere」——镯吸走断臂之羽（hexagram glyph 显现、如吸髓）——「There is one less, now」——神骨手镯更强。
Nikolas 的误读：接住落下的 Risha（「It's Taesia」）；看见 Rian 面容=花园之问那日——「The weapon wasn't to stop Taesia, but to stop Varrick」——夺枪升空（Rian 喊「Nik, Varrick is—!」没听完）。
facts.anchor: He grabbed the Lumin pistol out of Rian’s hand

facts.fact: 一枪：Nikolas 以 Lumin pistol 装填光球开火——Varrick 之首落桥（Taesia 先已双手劈剑斩颈）；其子（teenager、握过大之矛）目睹痛哭——Nyx 令「Finish you started」、她腿不由自主——Nikolas 枪响救场。
facts.anchor: Varrick ost Phos’s head fell to the bridge.

facts.fact: 中弹与告白：她 side/chest/arm 中弹——「I would’ve preferred a ‘thank you.’」「The summer solstice. Varrick may be down, but the plans he put into motion aren't.」——「No matter where you run, we're going to find you. We're going to end this.」
收幕：她以同一句挑战回应（Julian 梦境那句）——影幕开门、如黑色缝线合拢消失。
